audience: Vietnamese shops and retailers that sell and manage stock with KiotViet

useCases.title: Check stock by branch
useCases.text: The AI shows stock on hand and reserved quantities per product and branch, so you can see what is running low where.

useCases.title: Review the day's sales
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices for a date range with totals and payment status, and opens one invoice with its lines and payments.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their orders
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by code, name or phone, shows debt and totals, and lists the latest orders of that customer.

useCases.title: Take a sales order
useCases.text: The AI creates a sales order with lines of existing products in a branch, after you confirm the products, quantities and prices.

useCases.title: Add a new customer
useCases.text: The AI checks by phone number whether the customer exists, and creates a new customer record when it does not.

useCases.title: Review supplier purchases
useCases.text: The AI lists goods receipts and supplier orders for a period, with suppliers, totals and lines, so you can see what you bought.
